channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Parlamentares chamam isenção da 'taxa das blusinhas' de eleitoreira, e petistas evitam críticas em público
item.description: Lawmakers criticized the Lula government's decision to exempt the 20% tax on international shipments under US$50, known as the 'blusinhas tax,' calling it an electioneering move. PT members avoided public criticism of the measure, remaining silent or offering discreet support.

item.title: Sistema eletrônico de votação é patrimônio institucional da democracia, diz Nunes Marques
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, upon assuming the presidency of the TSE, defended electronic voting machines as an institutional heritage of democracy and stated that Brazil's electoral system is the most advanced in the world. He emphasized the security and reliability of the electoral process during his inauguration ceremony in Brasília.

item.title: Nunes Marques: Uso exponencial da IA é desafio nas eleições
item.description: Justice Kassio Nunes Marques, the new president of Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE), stated that the exponential use of artificial intelligence poses a challenge in elections, emphasizing the need to balance technological innovation with respect for freedom of expression and thought. He underscored the importance of safeguarding electoral integrity amid the rapid advancement of AI tools.

item.title: Ministro do TSE enaltece 'senso de medida' e 'capacidade de aproximação' de Nunes Marques
item.description: Minister Antonio Carlos Ferreira of the TSE praised Minister Kássio Nunes Marques for his 'sense of measure' and 'capacity for rapprochement', highlighting important qualities for leading the court. Nunes Marques was recently sworn in as president of the TSE.

item.title: Ministro diz que Trump ficou ‘chocado’ ao ouvir Lula dizer que rejeitou tornozeleira para ser solto
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan said Donald Trump was 'shocked' to hear Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva reject an offer to wear an electronic ankle monitor to be released from prison during Operation Car Wash, stating he preferred to prove his innocence. Durigan added that Trump was moved by Lula’s story, including his poor childhood and over 500 days in prison, and called Lula’s refusal to accept freedom at any cost 'a unique figure'.

item.title: Nunes Marques defende a democracia e fala sobre perigos da IA nas eleições em posse no TSE
item.description: Justice Kassio Nunes Marques assumed the presidency of the TSE on May 12, 2026, warning about the dangers of unregulated artificial intelligence in elections and defending democracy as a system of continuous self-correction. He replaces Minister Cármen Lúcia and will oversee the October 2026 general elections, which will determine the president, governors, senators, and federal and state deputies. His priorities include combating disinformation, regulating AI use in campaigns, expanding indigenous participation, and maintaining trust in electronic voting machines.

item.title: Governo publica MP que acaba com 'taxa das blusinhas' e encerra cobrança de 20% sobre compras internacionais
item.description: The government published a provisional measure ending the 'blusinhas tax', eliminating the 20% import duty on goods up to US$50 and reducing the taxable base for items between US$50 and US$3,000 with a US$30 deduction. The move aims to boost President Lula's popularity amid rising competitiveness of Flávio Bolsonaro in polls, responding to political pressure for tax relief on low-income consumption.

item.title: Alcolumbre não bate palmas para Messias durante posse de Nunes Marques no TSE
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre did not clasp for Attorney General Jorge Messias during the inauguration of Minister Nunes Marques as TSE president. The gesture followed the Senate’s rejection two weeks prior of Messias’s nomination to the STF — the first such rejection since 1894. Alcolumbre, Chamber President Hugo Motta, and STF President Edson Fachin also refrained from applauding, while Lula clapped briefly, highlighting the growing tension between the Executive and the Senate.

item.title: TSE, que tornou Bolsonaro inelegível, passa a ser comandado por Nunes Marques
item.description: Nunes Marques and André Mendonça assumed the presidency and vice-presidency of the TSE, becoming the first Bolsonaro appointees to lead the court. The new president emphasized a less interventionist stance, defended freedom of expression, praised Brazil’s electronic voting system, and warned of the risks posed by disordered AI use in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Nunes Marques exalta sistema eleitoral brasileiro “mais avançado do mundo”
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, the new president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), praised Brazil's electronic voting system as the 'most advanced in the world'. He emphasized that the model is an institutional heritage of Brazilian democracy, highlighting its efficiency in vote reception and processing.

item.title: Chefes dos Três Poderes participam da posse de Nunes Marques no TSE
item.description: Nunes Marques and André Mendonça were sworn in as president and vice-president of the TSE, respectively, in a ceremony attended by leaders of the Three Powers, including Lula, Alcolumbre, and Fachin. Nunes Marques emphasized the challenges of the 2026 elections, particularly combating fake news and the misuse of artificial intelligence. Cármen Lúcia, former TSE president, reaffirmed her commitment to democracy and women's participation in positions of power.

item.title: O aviso de Moraes ao relator do PL da Dosimetria que animou os bolsonaristas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes informed Deputy Paulinho da Força, rapporteur of the Dosimetry Bill in the Chamber, of a timeline for bringing the matter to the Court’s plenary session, with voting expected in the last week of May. This boosted Bolsonarista morale, despite Paulinho denying he discussed the vote’s outlook with Moraes. Behind the scenes, the expectation is that most justices will uphold the Dosimetry Law’s validity.

item.title: Por que o brasileiro pagou a ‘taxa das blusinhas’ por dois anos?
item.description: The 'tax on little shirts', introduced in August 2024 with a 20% import duty on international purchases under $50, was revoked by Lula on March 12, 2025, after two years in effect. Despite claims of curbing fraud and boosting national industry, the policy failed to achieve its goals, as imported goods remained cheaper and enforcement was partially delegated to platforms like Shein and Shopee. The repeal comes amid electoral politics, with polls showing the tax was among the worst-perceived policies of Lula’s government, indicating public backlash and strategic calculation ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: “Não usem meu nome em vão”, diz Mello Araújo
item.description: São Paulo's Vice Mayor, Colonel Mello Araújo, asked that his name not be used in discussions about the Bolsonarist Senate candidacy. The statement came after federal deputy Ricardo Salles said he would withdraw his candidacy if Alesp President André do Prado were considered for the position.

item.title: Alcolumbre evita bater palmas para Messias, que é aplaudido em posse do TSE
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) refrained from clapping for Attorney General Jorge Messias during the inauguration ceremony of Minister Kassio Nunes Marques as president of the TSE. The gesture sparked speculation about institutional tensions, although Messias received applause from other attendees. The event took place on May 12, 2026, during the swearing-in of the new TSE president.

item.title: Zema diz que manterá candidatura e quer vice “ficha limpa” em 2026
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for the presidency, stated he will maintain his candidacy through the 2026 elections and is seeking a running mate with a 'clean record'. He made the remarks during a press conference at Lide in New York, also addressing speculation surrounding his campaign.

item.title: Reunião entre Lula e Trump foi marcada por respeito mútuo, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan described the meeting between Lula and Trump as marked by mutual respect and deference, noting the informal opening and personal exchanges, including Lula’s childhood and imprisonment. The agenda covered bilateral trade, international organized crime, and strategic mineral exploration, with Brazil challenging the U.S. narrative of a trade deficit. Durigan said Trump’s admiration for Lula increased after the meeting.

item.title: Michelle vai ao TSE para posse de Nunes Marques, indicado por Bolsonaro
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro attended the swearing-in of Minister Nunes Marques as the new president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on May 12, 2026. Marques, appointed to the Supreme Federal Court by Jair Bolsonaro in 2020, invited the former president, who is under house arrest, though his attendance would have required authorization from Alexandre de Moraes. The event also featured First Lady Janja Lula da Silva and Viviane de Moraes, wife of Minister Alexandre de Moraes, with whom Michelle exchanged brief greetings.

item.title: Nunes Marques promete atuar contra uso de IA para desinformação
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques was sworn in as president of the Superior Electoral Court on May 12, 2026, pledging to counter the irregular use of artificial intelligence in the 2026 elections. He emphasized the need for political awareness amid algorithmic influence on public debate and stressed that democracy’s future will not be dictated by machines.

item.title: Oposição protocola novo pedido de impeachment contra Moraes
item.description: The leader of the opposition in the Chamber of Deputies, Cabo Gilberto Silva (PL-PB), filed a new impeachment request against Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, accusing him of overstepping his authority by individually suspending the Dosimetria Bill, which reduces penalties for those involved in the January 8 attacks. The opposition claims the move violates constitutional principles, undermines congressional authority, and creates legal insecurity. The request, grounded in the 1950 Impeachment Law, seeks Moraes’ removal and an eight-year ban from public office.

item.title: Varejo e indústria reagem e criticam fim da 'taxa das blusinhas'
item.description: President Lula's decision to eliminate the 'blusinhas' tax on imported goods under US$50 has drawn sharp criticism from retail and industry groups, who argue it creates unfair competition, harms domestic producers, and threatens jobs. Coalizão Prospera Brasil, ABVTEX, and CNI warn that removing the 20% import duty benefits foreign competitors while Brazilian firms face high taxes, interest rates, and regulatory burdens. They urge compensatory measures to prevent deindustrialization and job losses.

item.title: Revogação da taxa das blusinhas ajuda Haddad em SP, avalia PT
item.description: The revocation of the 'blusinhas tax' strengthens Fernando Haddad's candidacy for governor of São Paulo, while also boosting Lula's re-election prospects. The PT assesses that the measure, which reduces consumer costs, generates popular approval and improves the party's image in the state.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Cleitinho fecham aliança em Minas Gerais, mas ainda sem candidato definido
item.description: Senators Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and Cleitinho (Republicanos-MG) have signed a mutual support agreement in Minas Gerais, though no specific candidate has yet been named for the state government. Cleitinho leads polls for the Minas Gerais governorship, while Flávio Bolsonaro is a pre-candidate for president in 2026. The alliance strengthens the Bolsonarist base in the state, one of Brazil’s largest electoral colleges.

item.title: Nunes Marques assume presidência do TSE, cita preocupação com IA e defende liberdade de expressão
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques assumed the presidency of the TSE, expressing concern over the use of artificial intelligence in elections and asserting that Brazil's Electoral Justice has the necessary tools to address the technology. He defended freedom of expression, acknowledging the challenges of disinformation on social media, and stated that the future of democracy depends on the people's will, not machines.

item.title: PGR pede ao STF condenação de Eduardo Boslonaro por coação
item.description: The Prosecutor General's Office asked the Supreme Federal Court to convict former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro for the crime of coercion, alleging he attempted to obstruct investigations into the attempted coup d'état. The case is linked to the conviction of his father, Jair Bolsonaro, who was sentenced to over 27 years in prison for his involvement in the same events.

item.title: Sistema eletrônico é 'patrimônio institucional da nossa democracia', diz Nunes Marques ao tomar posse na presidência do TSE
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques, upon assuming the presidency of the TSE, highlighted Brazil's electronic voting system as an institutional heritage of democracy, praising its advanced technology and stressing the need for continuous improvement. He emphasized that democracy relies on institutional self-correction, protection of the informational space from disinformation and manipulation, and prudent use of Artificial Intelligence in elections. He also stated that successful elections must faithfully capture the voice of every citizen, preserving freedom of expression with responsibility.

item.title: Indústria têxtil nacional critica fim da 'taxa das blusinhas', anunciada por Lula: 'decisão extremamente equivocada', diz Abit
item.description: The Brazilian Textile Industry Association (Abit) strongly criticized President Lula's decision to abolish the 'blusinhas tax' on international purchases under US$50, calling it 'extremely misguided' and harmful to domestic industry, formal retail, and job creation. Abit argues the move worsens tax inequality between Brazilian firms and foreign platforms that already benefit from subsidies in their home countries, threatening investment and federal revenue.

item.title: Tribunal suspende temporariamente decisão que considerou ilegais as novas tarifas de Trump e mantém cobrança
item.description: A U.S. Federal Appeals Court temporarily suspended a ruling that had deemed Trump’s global tariffs illegal, maintaining the 10% import taxes while the government appeals. The move comes as tariff refund claims in the U.S. reach $35.5 billion. In Brazil, Lula announced the end of the 'little shirts tax' — a 20% fee on international online purchases — five months ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Ações sobre Lei da Dosimetria serão votadas no final de maio; STF deve manter redução de penas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes suspended the application of the Dosimetry Law until late May, when the plenary is expected to rule on its constitutionality. The 2025 law allows sentence reductions for those convicted in the January 8, 2023 attacks, including former President Jair Bolsonaro. The Court is likely to uphold the law, which would benefit defendants seeking sentence reductions.

item.title: Entenda o que é a 'taxa das blusinhas' e o vaivém do imposto
item.description: President Lula (PT) signed a provisional measure that eliminates the federal tax on international purchases up to US$50, popularly known as the 'blusinhas tax'. The announcement was made at the Planalto Palace after internal government debate and comes months ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula zera 'taxa das blusinhas'; compras da China até U$$ 50 não serão mais taxadas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a Provisional Measure eliminating the 20% Import Tax on international purchases up to US$ 50, commonly known as the 'tax on small packages'. The measure aims to lower the cost of imported consumer goods for individuals and boost low-value cross-border e-commerce.

item.title: Kassio Nunes Marques assina termo de posse como presidente do TSE
item.description: Ministers Kassio Nunes Marques and André Mendonça signed the terms of office as president and vice-president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), respectively. The ceremony took place on Wednesday, marking the beginning of their leadership of the Electoral Justice for the 2025-2027 biennium. The appointment reinforces the independence and impartiality of the TSE ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Começa cerimônia de posse de Kássio Nunes Marques na presidência do TSE
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) began on Tuesday night, the 12th, the swearing-in ceremony of Minister Kássio Nunes Marques as president and André Mendonça as vice-president of the Court. The solemnity marks the start of their mandates in the presidency and vice-presidency of the TSE for the 2025-2026 biennium.

item.title: Nunes Marques é empossado como presidente do TSE
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques was sworn in as the new president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), replacing Minister Cármen Lúcia, with André Mendonça as vice-president. The ceremony took place on Tuesday, the 12th, and the article is being updated.

item.title: Bia Kicis diz que Lula age por eleição ao rever “taxação das blusinhas”
item.description: Federal Deputy Bia Kicis (PL-DF) accused President Lula of acting with electoral motives by abolishing the so-called "blusinhas tax", which removes the 20% import duty on international online purchases up to US$ 50. She claimed the move was designed to please voters in an election year, disregarding fiscal consequences and harm to domestic industry.

item.title: “I love you”: o telefonema entre Trump e Lula pelo celular de Joesley
item.description: President Lula secured a visit to Washington through a phone call with Donald Trump made via the cellphone of businessman Joesley Batista. The call took place at the Palácio da Alvorada on the eve of the May 1 holiday, after Lula mentioned difficulties in scheduling an in-person meeting with the U.S. president.

item.title: “Tinha que ter eleição todo mês”, diz Flávio sobre fim da taxa das blusinhas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the revocation of the 20% import tax on international purchases up to US$ 50 (known as the 'blusinhas tax'), stating that 'there should be an election every month' because of the measure. He called the Lula government's decision harmful to trade and consumers, advocating for the tariff's maintenance as a way to protect national industry.

item.title: Após reunião com Moraes, relator de Lei da Dosimetria diz estar ‘confiante’ que texto terá validade
item.description: Paulinho da Força, rapporteur of the Dosimetry Law, expressed confidence in the law's validity after meeting with Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, expecting a ruling in late May. The law, which reduces sentences for those convicted of the January 8 attacks and benefits Jair Bolsonaro, had its application suspended by Moraes pending review of two ADIs challenging its constitutionality.

item.title: ‘Taxa das blusinhas’ era acertada, mas impopular. Em ano eleitoral, Lula recuou
item.description: The 'Blusinhas Tax,' introduced in 2024 to levy duties on low-value international purchases under $50, was deemed a sound policy to correct e-commerce distortions, but was abandoned by Lula in an election year due to its unpopularity. The government replaced it with the Remessa Conforme system, preserving enforcement goals while avoiding political backlash.

item.title: PT se reúne com Pacheco, mas aliança em MG segue aberta
item.description: The PT met with Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB-MG) to discuss his potential candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026, but negotiations remain open. PT president Edinho Silva said the party still needs to consult its Minas Gerais base and that Pacheco is not satisfied with just the party's blessing, demanding political structure and proper timing. Lula views Pacheco as the ideal candidate and has no 'plan B', while Pacheco sees a TCU appointment as a 'career end', preferring the visibility of running for state executive.

item.title: Caiado chama Lula de ‘cara de pau’ por criar plano contra crime próximo da eleição
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) accused President Lula of being 'shameless' for launching a plan to combat organized crime only five months before the 2026 elections, arguing it should have been implemented from the start of his administration. Caiado criticized the plan for allocating one billion reais from the federal budget and ten billion reais in BNDES credit lines, claiming it would indebt states and municipalities to pay high interest, constituting a form of 'loan-sharking' by the federal government.

item.title: Nunes Marques toma posse como presidente do TSE com presença Lula, Flávio e cúpula do Congresso
item.description: Kássio Nunes Marques was sworn in as president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) in a ceremony attended by Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and authorities from the Three Powers. The event marked the first public meeting between Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre since the Senate rejected Jorge Messias’ STF nomination. Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the TSE’s conduct in the 2022 elections, called for neutrality in 2026, and said he would greet Lula if they crossed paths.

item.title: Lula agiu agora para não perder bandeira de redução da 'taxa das blusinhas' para oposição
item.description: Lula signed a provisional measure eliminating the 20% import tax on purchases up to $50, aiming to retain ownership of the 'tax on small packages' issue amid opposition advances. The move comes despite internal resistance from retailers and industry, including Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, and seeks to prevent the opposition from co-opting the policy narrative.

item.title: La UE prohibirá la importación de carne desde Brasil a partir de septiembre
item.description: The European Union will ban the import of Brazilian meat and other animal-origin products for human consumption starting September 3, citing Brazil's failure to meet rules requiring products to be free of antimicrobials used for growth promotion. The government of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said it will present its arguments in Brussels on Wednesday to reverse the measure, which is part of the EU's efforts to reduce antibiotic resistance.

item.title: Nunes Marques e André Mendonça assumem comando do TSE com Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro na posse
item.description: Kassio Nunes Marques assumed the presidency of the TSE with André Mendonça as vice-president, in a ceremony marked by the presence of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, both candidates for re-election in 2026. The event also featured Michelle Bolsonaro, Viviane Barci, and Yara de Abreu, alongside political and judicial authorities. Nunes Marques and Mendonça, appointed by Jair Bolsonaro, will oversee the 2026 elections, focusing on combating misinformation and AI-generated content.

item.title: Pressão, desgaste e recuos: a trajetória da taxa das blusinhas no governo Lula
item.description: The Lula government abolished the 'blusinhas tax,' a 20% federal levy on international purchases under $50, after nearly three years of pressure from domestic retailers, lobbying by Asian e-commerce giants, and public backlash. Initially introduced to counter unfair competition, the tax was widely criticized on social media as a burden on low-income consumers, prompting a partial retreat and eventual full repeal. The policy's reversal highlights the tension between protecting local industry, fiscal revenue, and maintaining affordable access to imported goods in the era of global e-commerce.

item.title: MPT abre investigação contra Zema por ‘apologia ao trabalho infantil’
item.description: The Labor Public Ministry opened an investigation against Romeu Zema for alleged apology of child labor, after he proposed in an interview to allow children to work in Brazil if elected. The complaint was filed by the Mixed Parliamentary Front for Combating Child Labor, which claims his statements signal a political project to dismantle decades of civilizational progress and violate constitutional petrified clauses. Zema initially used the term 'child' but later changed it to 'adolescent' in a follow-up video, maintaining his stance.

item.title: Acompanhe, ao vivo, a posse do ministro Nunes Marques na Presidência do TSE
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques was sworn in as president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on Tuesday, March 12, at 7 p.m., in a ceremony held in the court's plenary in Brasília. In the same session, Minister André Mendonça assumed the vice-presidency of the court. Under his leadership, the TSE will oversee the 2026 General Elections, focusing on electronic ballot security, countering disinformation, and strengthening public trust in Brazil's electoral system.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre se encontram pela 1ª vez em posse no TSE depois de derrota de Messias ao STF
item.description: President Lula and Senator Alcolumbre met publicly for the first time at the swearing-in of Minister Kassio Nunes Marques at the TSE, following the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF. The meeting took place amid tension, as Lula's allies accuse Alcolumbre of orchestrating Messias' defeat, which he denies. The situation reveals fractures in the government's base, with divisions over how the administration should respond to the Senate's rebuke.

item.title: Nunes Marques assume presidência do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral
item.description: Kassio Nunes Marques assumed the presidency of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on Tuesday (12), succeeding Minister Cármen Lúcia and taking command of the Electoral Court for the October 2026 elections. He was elected to the position in April and will serve until May 2027. The ceremony was attended by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Senate and Chamber presidents, and other STF ministers.
